# How to test ad creatives on TikTok and Meta — from one winning ad

**One winning ad and its metrics become a test plan: distinct concepts, budgets, when to judge, file names, kill or scale calls.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_440e42519df7.webp" alt="Four genuinely different ad concepts play in a row as a test set: a pet nail clipper hook, a man relaxing in a heated neck massager, a backyard security-light hook and a glove-slicing demo." width="480"></p>

Turn one winning ad into a creative testing plan for TikTok and Meta. Decodes why an ad won (hook, argument, buyer, format), plans concepts that Meta's Andromeda and TikTok treat as genuinely different (buyer × angle × format × first frame, not caption swaps), sets how many creatives to launch, the budget per test and when to judge, writes file and ad names that make results readable, reads hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA to find which part failed, and says when to kill, iterate or scale. Use when someone asks how many ads to test, how to make ad variants, why their variants all perform the same, whether an ad is fatigued, when to kill an ad, or how to scale a winner. NOT for producing the videos (use ecommerce-video-ads, ecommerce-video-edit or product-video-hooks) or for media-buying account setup.

## Ask your agent

- "Here's my best-selling serum ad, plan the next 10 creatives to test on Meta with a $1,500 budget"
- "My 5 TikTok variants all perform the same — here is ./ads-export.csv, what is broken?"
- "Is this ad fatigued? CPM is up 25% and CTR down 18% this week, should I kill it or iterate?"
